framework.name: NIST SP 800-171A
framework.description: Assessing Security Requirements for Controlled Unclassified Information

controls.title: Limit System Access Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: authorized users are identified.; processes acting on behalf of authorized users are identified.; devices (including other systems) authorized to connect to the system are identified.

controls.title: Limit System Access Assessment [a]
controls.description: authorized users are identified.

controls.title: Limit System Access Assessment [b]
controls.description: processes acting on behalf of authorized users are identified.

controls.title: Limit System Access Assessment [c]
controls.description: devices (including other systems) authorized to connect to the system are identified.

controls.title: Limit System Access Assessment [d]
controls.description: system access is limited to authorized users.

controls.title: Limit System Access Assessment [e]
controls.description: system access is limited to processes acting on behalf of authorized users.

controls.title: Limit System Access Assessment [f]
controls.description: system access is limited to authorized devices (including other systems).

controls.title: Limit Transaction and Function Access Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: the types of transactions and functions that authorized users are permitted to execute are defined; system access is limited to the defined types of transactions and functions for authorized users.

controls.title: Limit Transaction and Function Access Assessment [a]
controls.description: the types of transactions and functions that authorized users are permitted to execute are defined

controls.title: Limit Transaction and Function Access Assessment [b]
controls.description: system access is limited to the defined types of transactions and functions for authorized users.

controls.title: Control CUI Flow Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: information flow control policies are defined.; methods and enforcement mechanisms for controlling the flow of CUI are defined.; designated sources and destinations (e.g., networks, individuals, and devices) for CUI within systems and between interconnected systems are identified.

controls.title: Control CUI Flow Assessment [a]
controls.description: information flow control policies are defined.

controls.title: Control CUI Flow Assessment [b]
controls.description: methods and enforcement mechanisms for controlling the flow of CUI are defined.

controls.title: Control CUI Flow Assessment [c]
controls.description: designated sources and destinations (e.g., networks, individuals, and devices) for CUI within systems and between interconnected systems are identified.

controls.title: Control CUI Flow Assessment [d]
controls.description: authorizations for controlling the flow of CUI are defined.

controls.title: Control CUI Flow Assessment [e]
controls.description: approved authorizations for controlling the flow of CUI are enforced.

controls.title: Separation of Duties Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: the duties of individuals requiring separation to reduce the risk of malevolent activity are defined.; organization-defined duties of individuals requiring separation are separated.; separate accounts for individuals whose duties and accesses must be separated to reduce the risk of malevolent activity or collusion are established

controls.title: Separation of Duties Assessment [a]
controls.description: the duties of individuals requiring separation to reduce the risk of malevolent activity are defined.

controls.title: Separation of Duties Assessment [b]
controls.description: organization-defined duties of individuals requiring separation are separated.

controls.title: Separation of Duties Assessment [c]
controls.description: separate accounts for individuals whose duties and accesses must be separated to reduce the risk of malevolent activity or collusion are established

controls.title: Least Privilege Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: privileged accounts are identified.; access to privileged accounts is authorized in accordance with the principle of least privilege.; security functions are identified.

controls.title: Least Privilege Assessment [a]
controls.description: privileged accounts are identified.

controls.title: Least Privilege Assessment [b]
controls.description: access to privileged accounts is authorized in accordance with the principle of least privilege.

controls.title: Least Privilege Assessment [c]
controls.description: security functions are identified.

controls.title: Least Privilege Assessment [d]
controls.description: access to security functions is authorized in accordance with the principle of least privilege.

controls.title: Use Non-Privileged Accounts Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: nonsecurity functions are identified.; users are required to use non-privileged accounts or roles when accessing nonsecurity functions.

controls.title: Use Non-Privileged Accounts Assessment [a]
controls.description: nonsecurity functions are identified.

controls.title: Use Non-Privileged Accounts Assessment [b]
controls.description: users are required to use non-privileged accounts or roles when accessing nonsecurity functions.

controls.title: Prevent Non-Privileged Users from Executing Privileged Functions Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: privileged functions are defined.; non-privileged users are defined.; non-privileged users are prevented from executing privileged functions.

controls.title: Prevent Non-Privileged Users from Executing Privileged Functions Assessment [a]
controls.description: privileged functions are defined.

controls.title: Prevent Non-Privileged Users from Executing Privileged Functions Assessment [b]
controls.description: non-privileged users are defined.

controls.title: Prevent Non-Privileged Users from Executing Privileged Functions Assessment [c]
controls.description: non-privileged users are prevented from executing privileged functions.

controls.title: Prevent Non-Privileged Users from Executing Privileged Functions Assessment [d]
controls.description: the execution of privileged functions is captured in audit logs.

controls.title: Limit Unsuccessful Logon Attempts Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: the means of limiting unsuccessful logon attempts is defined.; the defined means of limiting unsuccessful logon attempts is implemented.

controls.title: Limit Unsuccessful Logon Attempts Assessment [a]
controls.description: the means of limiting unsuccessful logon attempts is defined.

controls.title: Limit Unsuccessful Logon Attempts Assessment [b]
controls.description: the defined means of limiting unsuccessful logon attempts is implemented.

controls.title: Privacy and Security Notices Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: privacy and security notices required by CUI-specified rules are identified, consistent, and associated with the specific CUI category; privacy and security notices are displayed.

controls.title: Privacy and Security Notices Assessment [a]
controls.description: privacy and security notices required by CUI-specified rules are identified, consistent, and associated with the specific CUI category

controls.title: Privacy and Security Notices Assessment [b]
controls.description: privacy and security notices are displayed.

controls.title: Session Lock Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: the period of inactivity after which the system initiates a session lock is defined.; access to the system and viewing of data is prevented by initiating a session lock after the defined period of inactivity.; previously visible information is concealed via a pattern-hiding display after the defined period of inactivity.

controls.title: Session Lock Assessment [a]
controls.description: the period of inactivity after which the system initiates a session lock is defined.

controls.title: Session Lock Assessment [b]
controls.description: access to the system and viewing of data is prevented by initiating a session lock after the defined period of inactivity.

controls.title: Session Lock Assessment [c]
controls.description: previously visible information is concealed via a pattern-hiding display after the defined period of inactivity.

controls.title: Session Termination Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: conditions requiring a user session to terminate are defined.; a user session is automatically terminated after any of the defined conditions occur.

controls.title: Session Termination Assessment [a]
controls.description: conditions requiring a user session to terminate are defined.

controls.title: Session Termination Assessment [b]
controls.description: a user session is automatically terminated after any of the defined conditions occur.

controls.title: Control Remote Access Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: remote access sessions are permitted.; the types of permitted remote access are identified.; remote access sessions are controlled.

controls.title: Control Remote Access Assessment [a]
controls.description: remote access sessions are permitted.

controls.title: Control Remote Access Assessment [b]
controls.description: the types of permitted remote access are identified.

controls.title: Control Remote Access Assessment [c]
controls.description: remote access sessions are controlled.

controls.title: Control Remote Access Assessment [d]
controls.description: remote access sessions are monitored.

controls.title: Route Remote Access via Managed Access Control Points Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote access sessions are identified.; cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote access sessions are implemented.

controls.title: Route Remote Access via Managed Access Control Points Assessment [a]
controls.description: cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote access sessions are identified.

controls.title: Route Remote Access via Managed Access Control Points Assessment [b]
controls.description: cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote access sessions are implemented.

controls.title: Limit Remote Access via Managed Access Control Points Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: managed access control points are identified and implemented.; remote access is routed through managed network access control points.

controls.title: Limit Remote Access via Managed Access Control Points Assessment [a]
controls.description: managed access control points are identified and implemented.

controls.title: Limit Remote Access via Managed Access Control Points Assessment [b]
controls.description: remote access is routed through managed network access control points.

controls.title: Authorize Remote Execution Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: privileged commands authorized for remote execution are identified.; security-relevant information authorized to be accessed remotely is identified.; the execution of the identified privileged commands via remote access is authorized.

controls.title: Authorize Remote Execution Assessment [a]
controls.description: privileged commands authorized for remote execution are identified.

controls.title: Authorize Remote Execution Assessment [b]
controls.description: security-relevant information authorized to be accessed remotely is identified.

controls.title: Authorize Remote Execution Assessment [c]
controls.description: the execution of the identified privileged commands via remote access is authorized.

controls.title: Authorize Remote Execution Assessment [d]
controls.description: access to the identified security-relevant information via remote access is authorized.

controls.title: Authorize Wireless Access Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: wireless access points are identified.; wireless access is authorized prior to allowing such connections.

controls.title: Authorize Wireless Access Assessment [a]
controls.description: wireless access points are identified.

controls.title: Authorize Wireless Access Assessment [b]
controls.description: wireless access is authorized prior to allowing such connections.

controls.title: Protect Wireless Access Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: wireless access to the system is protected using encryption.; wireless access to the system is protected using authentication.

controls.title: Protect Wireless Access Assessment [a]
controls.description: wireless access to the system is protected using encryption.

controls.title: Protect Wireless Access Assessment [b]
controls.description: wireless access to the system is protected using authentication.

controls.title: Control Connection of Mobile Devices Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: mobile devices that process, store, or transmit CUI are identified.; the connection of mobile devices is authorized.; mobile device connections are monitored and logged.

controls.title: Control Connection of Mobile Devices Assessment [a]
controls.description: mobile devices that process, store, or transmit CUI are identified.

controls.title: Control Connection of Mobile Devices Assessment [b]
controls.description: the connection of mobile devices is authorized.

controls.title: Control Connection of Mobile Devices Assessment [c]
controls.description: mobile device connections are monitored and logged.

controls.title: Encrypt CUI on Mobile Devices Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: mobile devices and mobile computing platforms that process, store, or transmit CUI are identified.; encryption is employed to protect CUI on identified mobile devices and mobile computing platforms.

controls.title: Encrypt CUI on Mobile Devices Assessment [a]
controls.description: mobile devices and mobile computing platforms that process, store, or transmit CUI are identified.

controls.title: Encrypt CUI on Mobile Devices Assessment [b]
controls.description: encryption is employed to protect CUI on identified mobile devices and mobile computing platforms.

controls.title: Verify External Connections Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: connections to external systems are identified.; use of external systems is identified.; connections to external systems are verified.

controls.title: Verify External Connections Assessment [a]
controls.description: connections to external systems are identified.

controls.title: Verify External Connections Assessment [b]
controls.description: use of external systems is identified.

controls.title: Verify External Connections Assessment [c]
controls.description: connections to external systems are verified.

controls.title: Verify External Connections Assessment [d]
controls.description: use of external systems is verified.

controls.title: Verify External Connections Assessment [e]
controls.description: connections to external systems are controlled/limited.

controls.title: Verify External Connections Assessment [f]
controls.description: use of external systems is controlled/limited.

controls.title: Limit Use of Portable Storage Devices Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: use of organizational portable storage devices containing CUI on external systems is identified and documented.; limits on the use of organizational portable storage devices containing CUI on external systems are defined.; use of organizational portable storage devices containing CUI on external systems is limited as defined.

controls.title: Limit Use of Portable Storage Devices Assessment [a]
controls.description: use of organizational portable storage devices containing CUI on external systems is identified and documented.

controls.title: Limit Use of Portable Storage Devices Assessment [b]
controls.description: limits on the use of organizational portable storage devices containing CUI on external systems are defined.

controls.title: Limit Use of Portable Storage Devices Assessment [c]
controls.description: use of organizational portable storage devices containing CUI on external systems is limited as defined.

controls.title: Control Publicly Accessible Content Assessment
controls.description: Determine if CUI posted or processed on publicly accessible systems is controlled.

controls.title: Control Publicly Accessible Content Assessment [a]
controls.description: individuals authorized to post or process information on publicly accessible systems are identified.

controls.title: Control Publicly Accessible Content Assessment [b]
controls.description: procedures to ensure CUI is not posted or processed on publicly accessible systems are identified.

controls.title: Control Publicly Accessible Content Assessment [c]
controls.description: a review process in in place prior to posting of any content to publicly accessible systems.

controls.title: Control Publicly Accessible Content Assessment [d]
controls.description: content on publicly accessible information systems is reviewed to ensure that it does not include CUI.

controls.title: Control Publicly Accessible Content Assessment [e]
controls.description: mechanisms are in place to remove and address improper posting of CUI.

controls.title: Security Awareness Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: security risks associated with organizational activities involving CUI are identified.; policies, standards, and procedures related to the security of the system are identified.; managers, systems administrators, and users of the system are made aware of the security risks associated with their activities.

controls.title: Security Awareness Assessment [a]
controls.description: security risks associated with organizational activities involving CUI are identified.

controls.title: Security Awareness Assessment [b]
controls.description: policies, standards, and procedures related to the security of the system are identified.

controls.title: Security Awareness Assessment [c]
controls.description: managers, systems administrators, and users of the system are made aware of the security risks associated with their activities.

controls.title: Security Awareness Assessment [d]
controls.description: managers, systems administrators, and users of the system are made aware of the applicable policies, standards, and procedures related to the security of the system.

controls.title: Role-Based Security Training Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: information security-related duties, roles, and responsibilities are defined.; information security-related duties, roles, and responsibilities are assigned to designated personnel.; personnel are adequately trained to carry out their assigned information security-related duties, roles, and responsibilities.

controls.title: Role-Based Security Training Assessment [a]
controls.description: information security-related duties, roles, and responsibilities are defined.

controls.title: Role-Based Security Training Assessment [b]
controls.description: information security-related duties, roles, and responsibilities are assigned to designated personnel.

controls.title: Role-Based Security Training Assessment [c]
controls.description: personnel are adequately trained to carry out their assigned information security-related duties, roles, and responsibilities.

controls.title: Insider Threat Awareness Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: potential indicators associated with insider threats are identified.; security awareness training on recognizing and reporting potential indicators of insider threat is provided to managers and employees.

controls.title: Insider Threat Awareness Assessment [a]
controls.description: potential indicators associated with insider threats are identified.

controls.title: Insider Threat Awareness Assessment [b]
controls.description: security awareness training on recognizing and reporting potential indicators of insider threat is provided to managers and employees.

controls.title: System Auditing Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: audit logs needed (i.e., event types to be logged) to enable the monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized system activity are specified.; the content of audit records needed to support monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized system activity is defined.; audit records are created (generated).

controls.title: System Auditing Assessment [a]
controls.description: audit logs needed (i.e., event types to be logged) to enable the monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized system activity are specified.

controls.title: System Auditing Assessment [b]
controls.description: the content of audit records needed to support monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized system activity is defined.

controls.title: System Auditing Assessment [c]
controls.description: audit records are created (generated).

controls.title: System Auditing Assessment [d]
controls.description: audit records, once created, contain the defined content.

controls.title: System Auditing Assessment [e]
controls.description: retention requirements for audit records are defined.

controls.title: System Auditing Assessment [f]
controls.description: audit records are retained as defined.

controls.title: User Accountability Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: the content of the audit records needed to support the ability to uniquely trace users to their actions is defined.; audit records, once created, contain the defined content.

controls.title: User Accountability Assessment [a]
controls.description: the content of the audit records needed to support the ability to uniquely trace users to their actions is defined.

controls.title: User Accountability Assessment [b]
controls.description: audit records, once created, contain the defined content.

controls.title: Event Review Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: a process for determining when to review logged events is defined.; event types being logged are reviewed in accordance with the defined review process.; event types being logged are updated based on the review.

controls.title: Event Review Assessment [a]
controls.description: a process for determining when to review logged events is defined.

controls.title: Event Review Assessment [b]
controls.description: event types being logged are reviewed in accordance with the defined review process.

controls.title: Event Review Assessment [c]
controls.description: event types being logged are updated based on the review.

controls.title: Audit Failure Alerting Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: personnel or roles to be alerted in the event of an audit logging process failure are identified.; types of audit logging process failures for which alert will be generated are defined.; identified personnel or roles are alerted in the event of an audit logging process failure.

controls.title: Audit Failure Alerting Assessment [a]
controls.description: personnel or roles to be alerted in the event of an audit logging process failure are identified.

controls.title: Audit Failure Alerting Assessment [b]
controls.description: types of audit logging process failures for which alert will be generated are defined.

controls.title: Audit Failure Alerting Assessment [c]
controls.description: identified personnel or roles are alerted in the event of an audit logging process failure.

controls.title: Audit Correlation Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: audit record review, analysis, and reporting processes for investigation and response to indications of unlawful, unauthorized, suspicious, or unusual activity are defined.; defined audit record review, analysis, and reporting processes are correlated.

controls.title: Audit Correlation Assessment [a]
controls.description: audit record review, analysis, and reporting processes for investigation and response to indications of unlawful, unauthorized, suspicious, or unusual activity are defined.

controls.title: Audit Correlation Assessment [b]
controls.description: defined audit record review, analysis, and reporting processes are correlated.

controls.title: Audit Reduction and Reporting Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: an audit record reduction capability that supports on-demand analysis is provided.; a report generation capability that supports on-demand reporting is provided.

controls.title: Audit Reduction and Reporting Assessment [a]
controls.description: an audit record reduction capability that supports on-demand analysis is provided.

controls.title: Audit Reduction and Reporting Assessment [b]
controls.description: a report generation capability that supports on-demand reporting is provided.

controls.title: Authoritative Time Source Assessment
controls.description: Determine if: internal system clocks are used to generate time stamps for audit records.; an authoritative source with which to compare and synchronize internal system clocks is specified.; internal system clocks used to generate time stamps for audit records are compared to and synchronized with the specified authoritative time source.

controls.title: Authoritative Time Source Assessment [a]
controls.description: internal system clocks are used to generate time stamps for audit records.

controls.title: Authoritative Time Source Assessment [b]
controls.description: an authoritative source with which to compare and synchronize internal system clocks is specified.

controls.title: Authoritative Time Source Assessment [c]
controls.description: internal system clocks used to generate time stamps for audit records are compared to and synchronized with the specified authoritative time source.

controls.title: Audit Record Protection Assessment [b]

controls.title: Audit Record Protection Assessment [c]

controls.title: Audit Record Protection Assessment [f]

controls.title: Audit Management Assessment

controls.title: Audit Management Assessment [a]
controls.description: a subset of privileged users granted access to manage audit logging functionality is defined.

controls.title: Audit Management Assessment [b]

controls.title: Baseline Configurations Assessment [c]

controls.description: changes to the system are reviewed.

controls.title: System Change Management Assessment [c]
controls.description: changes to the system are approved or disapproved.

controls.title: Access Restrictions for Change Assessment [g]
controls.description: logical access restrictions associated with changes to the system are approved.

controls.title: Access Restrictions for Change Assessment [h]
